read.thesis: UPS is deliberately shrinking its largest customer's volume (Amazon, 11.8% of revenue) by over 50% by 2H26 to lift U.S. domestic margin to at least 12% by Q4 2026, with ~$1bn Efficiency Reimagined savings; 2025 U.S. ADV guided down ~8.5%.

capex.quote: Capital expenditures are expected to be about $3.5 billion.

triggers.label: Largest customer volume down >50% by 2H26
triggers.quote: lowering their volume with us by more than 50% by the second half of 2026

triggers.label: U.S. ADV guided down ~8.5%
triggers.quote: U.S. domestic ADV decline of about 8.5%

triggers.label: US domestic margin ≥12% by Q4 2026
